shortInfo: NPSC has announced notification for Stenographer (Grade-III) posts. Required qualification: Graduate, Diploma in Computer Operation, Shorthand. Last date to apply: 03-09-26.

howToApply: OTR (One Time Registration) will be available from noon of 21st August, 2026 till noon of 2nd September, 2026.
Only those candidates who are eligible to appear in Stenographer Exam-2026 may register.
Online application can be submitted through NPSC portal i.e. https://npsc.nagaland.gov.in from noon of 21st August, 2026 till noon of 3rd September, 2026.
Only OTR applications for Stenographer will be accepted.
For candidates who are Government employees, ‘No Objection Certificate’ should be uploaded while submitting online application.
OTR (One Time Registration) will be free of cost. Candidates have to pay examination fee of Rs. 300/-, convenience fee of Rs. 25/- and payment gateway charges as applicable.
Any issue/complaints must be settled on or before the last date of submission of application form.
For any queries/assistance, candidates can call the NPSC helpdesk number: 9402988506 on working days (10:00 hrs to 15:00 hrs).

howToApply: Visit Bank’s official website www.bankofbaroda.bank.in under Career section → Current Opportunities.
Register online in the appropriate Online Application Format available through the link on the Careers → Current Opportunities page.
Upload scanned photograph, signature, bio-data, and other required documents as per specifications.
Carefully fill in all details in the online application form. No changes are permitted after clicking SUBMIT.
Pay the application fee online using Debit Card / Credit Card / Internet Banking / UPI etc.
On successful payment, an e-receipt and application form will be generated — print and retain for future reference.
Note down the acknowledgement number and keep a copy of the application form for future reference.
Download call letters from the Bank’s website under Career section → Current Opportunities using registration details and password.
